name: Dsuo
description: Joint instance segmentation of objects in underwater images to evaluate instance segmentation models under underwater imaging conditions.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) / AP at IoU thresholds (standard instance segmentation metrics)
reputation: A specialized underwater instance-segmentation dataset with limited but growing use in marine and underwater imaging research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; domain-specific challenges such as low visibility, color distortion, and annotation difficulty; dataset scale may be limited.
